data.summary_en: Propose HarnessMM (Harness Minus Minus), replacing repeated inference calls at the model–tool boundary with protected decision reuse, and iteratively optimizing harness configuration via recursive self-improvement (RSI). On DeepSeek Harness, success rate rises from 71.43% to 85.71%, Tokens/task (k) falls from 96.28 to 11.62, saving 87.93%.
